persona: Calm and organised, writes in full sentences. Was at work when the hot water cylinder split and found the water when he got home; has a photo, the plumber's attendance note and a restoration quote.
initial_message: Hi, I'd like to make a claim for water damage at my house. When I got home from work on Thursday 10 September, the hot water cylinder in the hallway cupboard had split and water had soaked the hallway carpet and part of the main bedroom carpet. A plumber replaced the cylinder the next day, but the carpet and the bottom of the walls are damaged.

facts.incident.description: While I was at work the hot water cylinder in the hallway cupboard split near its base. When I got home the cupboard floor was flooded and water had spread along the hallway carpet and into the main bedroom. I turned the water off at the toby and the cylinder off at the switchboard and called an emergency plumber.
facts.incident.cause: The hot water cylinder in the hallway cupboard split at a seam near its base
facts.loss.description: Hallway carpet and about a third of the main bedroom carpet soaked; the bottom 30 cm of the plasterboard in the hallway and cupboard swollen; the particle-board floor of the cylinder cupboard swollen
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Turned the water off at the toby and the cylinder off at the switchboard, soaked up water with towels, and called an emergency plumber
facts.mitigation.temporary_repair: The plumber drained the old cylinder on Thursday night and installed a new cylinder on Friday 11 September 2026
facts.policyholder.name: Rawiri Mataishaw
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the wet hallway carpet and the swollen wall, taken on Thursday evening. Available now.
facts.evidence.attendance_note: The plumber's attendance note. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Tide Well Drying & Restoration dated 18 September 2026, total $6,980.50 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_cylinder_age: About 14 years old. It came with the house when we bought it.
facts.if_asked_about_plumber_cost: I paid the plumber $2,460 including GST for the call-out and the new cylinder. The invoice is in my email and I can send it later.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo taken in a narrow house hallway, crouching beside an open hallway cupboard and looking along the wall. In the foreground, just inside the open cupboard door, the particle-board cupboard floor is dark, soaked and swollen, with a puddle around the base of a white hot water cylinder. The hallway wall runs away from the camera on the right: its bottom 30 cm of white plasterboard is clearly swollen and bulging outward, the paint is blistered and peeling, and a dark brown water line runs along the wall about 30 cm above the skirting board, which is pushed away from the wall. The beige hallway carpet along the wall is dark and soaked. Warm ceiling light, evening. No people, no text.
materials.purpose: Shows the water damage to the hallway carpet, wall and cupboard floor

redo_history.rejection: The cupboard floor named in the purpose is not visible; then (redo round 1) the swollen bottom of the wall is not clear
redo_history.old_prompt: Realistic smartphone photo looking down a narrow house hallway with beige carpet that is dark and soaked with water along its whole length, a shallow puddle shining near an open cupboard door at the side. data.found: 180 L mains-pressure hot water cylinder in the hallway cupboard split at a seam near the base. Water had spread across the cupboard floor into the hallway and main bedroom carpets.
data.work_done: Isolated water and power to the cylinder and drained it on 10 September. Returned on Friday 11 September 2026 and installed a new 180 L mains-pressure cylinder; pressure-tested, no leaks.
data.follow_up: Carpets, cupboard floor and the bottom of the wall linings need drying and repair by a restoration company.

materials.purpose: Contractor record of the emergency work

design.notes: Planted feature coverage_uncertainty_marker: the pack policy is in the lookup with the uncertainty marker COVERAGE_SECTION_INCOMPLETE, which requires coverage_unclear. It is not a review indicator, so planted_indicators stays empty. The claimant starts anonymous and signs in before the first upload. The failed cylinder is about 14 years old, so a person also has to consider the wear-and-tear wording (HOM-EXC-02); the Agent must not decide it.

triage.rationale: The policy lookup returns the pack policy with the uncertainty marker COVERAGE_SECTION_INCOMPLETE, so coverage is unclear and a person must look (complex). The restoration quote totals NZD 6,980.50 including GST, over 5,000. Allowed but not required: if the Agent asks for the plumber's invoice, the claimant can only send it later (evidence_outstanding); it is not a required family material. Nobody is hurt, the leak is stopped and the home is habitable. The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

prior_claims_12m.basis: Starts anonymous, signs in before upload; the account has no earlier claims

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-01-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
